newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Auridiam, Kimberley in diamond pact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Auridiam, Kimberley in diamond pact.

text.p: Diamond producer Auridiam Consolidated NL said on Tuesday it had entered into a heads of agreement with Kimberley Diamond Corp NL over Auridiam's tenement EL04/726 in Western Australia.
Under the agreement, Kimberley has the right to earn up to a 60 percent interest in the tenement by the minimum expenditure of A$1.82 million, Auridiam said.

Auridiam said it retaining the right to contribute after expenditure of A$1.19 million by KDC, to maintain a 49 percent interest. Kimberley must spend A$100,000 on or before 8 August 1997, to earn a minimum 20 percent interest in the tenement.
To earn a 51 percent interest, Kimberley must also meet additional expenditure of A$1.09 million before August 8, 1999, Auridiam said.
